title: Sandbox Policy Planner
tagline: Choose isolation controls from an explicit capability requirement.
summary: Select a modeled isolation policy, inspect an optional local Docker invocation, and compare requested controls with observed harmless probes.
usefulFor: A sandbox evidence planner mapping requested capabilities to observed runtime probes.
Default output is a policy simulation.
youWillBuild: Select a modeled isolation policy, inspect an optional local Docker invocation, and compare requested controls with observed harmless probes.
skills: Select the least costly sufficient profile

stages.title: Parse the capability request
stages.summary: Represent the threat model as four explicit booleans: untrusted code, secret-bearing host, denied network and required kernel separation.

stages.title: Define modeled control profiles
stages.summary: Model process, filesystem, container-network and microVM boundaries as data.

stages.title: Select the least costly sufficient profile
stages.summary: Filter insufficient profiles before comparing cost.

stages.title: Report residual assumptions
stages.summary: Return the selected fixture and state clearly that operating-system enforcement has not been performed.
